per_finding_dispositions.authority: Each full body has exactly one current owner. CURRENT byte-identical aliases only may be CONTEXT_ONLY. No unchanged-body omission, old verdict inheritance or delta-only acceptance. Combined approval requires every owner and parent verification.

GD1.title: attempt_owner_manifest drops null-shadowed/contradictory nested identities and intent/launch runner_identity
GD1.repair: collect_record now collects EVERY readable identity field independently (item-with-start, identity_at_start, identity, start_identity; outer pid from pid or census leader_pid); a present null/malformed field never shadows another (malformed recorded as unknown); >=2 distinct readable (pid,start) at one item record 'contradictory readable identities' and all are added via add() (which retains outer/nested PID contradictions as two identities); collect_record is applied to EVERY readable intent/launch/nolaunch/settlement/QUARANTINE record as well as summary/closeout, so an emitted runner_identity is retained without any launch-record/summary/closeout runner publication.
independent_test_oracles: t_nested_identity_without_outer_pid (outer/nested contradiction + omission of every identity)
t_allocation_release (complete/legacy scenarios with intent runner identities)
GD1.residual_or_conditional: Parent certification semantics unchanged (exact (pid,start) keys). Manifest 'unknowns' remain informational except publication_unknowns; parent must review them.

GD2.title: legacy_audit bypasses explicit disposal of a missing CURRENT closeout
GD2.repair: LEGACY_NO_CLOSEOUT_LAUNCH_SCHEMAS = {PILOT-LAUNCH-v14, PILOT-LAUNCH-v32, PSTREAM-LAUNCH-v4} (verified by source: those runners never write closeout.json). release_refusals adds publication unknown 'mandatory current closeout publication absent' unless the BOUND launch bytes parse with a proven-legacy schema, and passes closeout_legacy_proven to disposition_refusals; there a missing closeout is admissible by legacy_audit ONLY when legacy is proven, otherwise ONLY by explicit publication_failure_disposed=True (audited release, never qualification).
independent_test_oracles: t_allocation_release: refused current_missing_closeout_with_bare_legacy_flag, unbound_legacy_launch_missing_closeout_with_legacy_flag; admitted twin current_missing_closeout_after_explicit_failure_disposition; legacy_after_explicit_parent_audit retained
GD2.residual_or_conditional: Legacy proof relies on the bound launch schema string; parent audit of legacy attempts remains required.

GD3.title: raw read/traversal descriptors outside the acquisition inventory
GD3.repair: Every raw acquisition is registered in RAW_FDS BEFORE the syscall; OSError proves not_acquired, any other exception leaves acquisition_uncertain; the observed {dev,ino,kind} (or explicit unavailable) is retained before any caller inspection; each acquired number gets exactly one owning close (raw_close) whose exception leaves close_uncertain (never retried); open_regular returns (fd, st, record) and accepts a pre-registered record so verify_sat/rehash TRANSFER the single record (no duplicate owner). unresolved_inventory reports every record unless coherently resolved (not_acquired without evidence; closed with one returned close; anchored only while TREE owns exactly fd+observed dev/ino). create_excl records its rollback close outcome.
independent_test_oracles: t_raw_read_walk_acquisition_inventory (registration-before-inspection, rollback/owning close uncertainty, OSError vs unknown acquisition, walk root/child, reuse sentinel)
t_raw_descriptor_ownership_contract (coherent/incoherent states incl. orphan anchor; anchor_dir; verify_sat transfer)
GD3.residual_or_conditional: CPython-internal descriptors (os.scandir streams, subprocess pipes, file-object internals) remain outside RAW_FDS by design; RAW_FDS grows append-only per acquisition (bounded by run work caps).

GD4.title: helper cancellation masks settlement-only safety defects
GD4.repair: _settle computes settlement_safety (native drift; exit observed beyond HELPER_WALL; settlement beyond HELPER_ALLOW; frozen abs/mono cutoffs) BEFORE classification and records it; cancellation-only HelperRefused requires stop==owner_cancel_sigterm, trips==['owner_cancel_sigterm'] AND no settlement safety; otherwise latch + RuntimeError. Single identity-checked SIGTERM path unchanged.
independent_test_oracles: t_helper_cancel_safety_precedence: cancel_with_settlement_only_drift, cancel_with_settlement_only_late_exit (RuntimeError, latch, one stop request) plus original cancel-only/safety cases
GD4.residual_or_conditional: clock() still converts RuntimeError into a latched 'required host clock failed' (unchanged).

GD5.title: publication success outlives its original operation allowance
GD5.repair: write_bytes_x fences the digest and success boundary against the ORIGINAL `end` before register_written/publication_complete (late => failed publication, publication_complete False). commit_record runs post-publication cutoff/confinement/preservation under STATE cleanup_deadline=min(prior,end) and appends a completion defect when completion is observed beyond `end`; the record returns original_operation_allowance_mono and the observed done time.
independent_test_oracles: t_commit_publication_original_allowance: timely twin commits; late post-publication preservation never commits and latches
GD5.residual_or_conditional: Global cutoffs still checked separately; OS call latency is not bounded (documented).

T1-5.title: persistent-identity oracle omits nested-only identity boundary
T1-5.repair: Oracle exercises the real remember_identity with nested-only and conflicting outer/nested observations and a pid-less observation (refused); production retains valid nested identities and both conflicting keys with explicit uncertainty.

T3-3.title: raw-inventory oracle excludes an orphaned anchor
T3-3.repair: Production treats 'anchored' as resolved only when TREE owns the exact fd+observed identity; the oracle now expects the orphan (and incoherent resolved-looking records) in the production unresolved set.

T3-4.title: acquisition-before-allowance ordering untested
T3-4.repair: Acquisition crossing the original allowance and a late successful nonempty read refuse with exactly one close and no further reads; production adds explicit post-acquisition fences.
